items.q: How accurate is the budget it suggests?
items.a: It is an estimate from the numbers you enter. Real results change with your offer, landing page, competition and audience, so treat it as a starting plan and review it after the first week.

items.q: What ROAS do I need to make a profit?
items.a: Break-even ROAS is 1 divided by your profit margin. At a 25% margin you need 4x just to break even, while at a 50% margin 2x is enough.

items.q: Is the ad budget calculator free?
items.a: Yes. The ad budget and ROAS calculator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Are my sales and spend numbers saved?
items.a: No. The maths runs in your browser and the numbers are not sent to us or stored.

items.q: Can you run my Google and Meta ads for me?
items.a: Yes. Our performance marketing team plans, launches and checks campaigns every week, reporting cost per qualified lead.
